title: Leveraging Recourse and Size Bounds for OnlineKnapsack with Removable Items
abstract: arXiv:2610.40290v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In the online unweighted knapsack problem, items arrive sequentially and must be accepted or rejected immediately for a bounded-capacity knapsack, aiming to maximize the total size of accepted items. When decisions are irrevocable, no algorithm achieves a non-trivial competitive ratio. An essential relaxation that circumvents this impossibility is to allow previously accepted items to be removed from the knapsack (a.k.a. removal). In this work, we investigate possible further improvements on the competitive ratio with removal by bringing together two other previously proposed model extensions: knowledge of an upper bound on the item sizes (a.k.a. bound awareness) and ability to reinsert previously rejected items(a.k.a.recourse). Our contributions are twofold. First, we establish close upper and lower bounds on the competitive ratio under bound awareness, removal and recourse. translated_title: 利用重插机制与尺寸上界研究带可移除物品的在线背包问题
translated_abstract: 在在线无权重背包问题中，物品依次到达，必须立即决定接受或拒绝，将其装入一个容量有限的背包，目标是最大化被接受物品的总大小。当决策不可撤销时，任何算法都无法达到非平凡的竞争比。一种规避这一不可能结果的重要放松是允许将之前已接受的物品从背包中移除（即“移除”机制）。在本工作中，我们通过结合另外两个先前提出的模型扩展，研究能否进一步提升带移除机制的竞争比：其一是知道物品大小的上界（即“上界感知”），其二是能够重新插入之前被拒绝的物品（即“重插”机制）。我们的贡献有两方面。首先，我们在上界感知、移除和重插机制下建立了竞争比的紧密上下界。我们证明了……（原文摘要在此处被截断）在最佳背包问题上可取得显著改进……
tldr: 该论文在带可移除物品的在线背包问题中，首次将物品大小上界感知与允许重插被拒物品的重插机制相结合，建立了竞争比的紧密上下界，并显著改进了已有的最优竞争比。
en_tdlr: The paper integrates bound awareness of item sizes with a recourse mechanism for reinserting rejected items into the online knapsack problem with removable items, establishing tight upper and lower bounds on the competitive ratio and achieving significant improvements over the best known ratios.
